title_en: At Tower Bridge 3 Complex, 1+1 Apartment For Sale Together With A Parking Post!!
description_en: At the Tower Bridge 3 complex, 1+1 apartment for sale! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a well-managed building, with an elevator. The orientation of the apartment is East, which allows natural light throughout the day. The apartment is organized by the living room connected to the kitchen corner, bedroom and toilet. The apartment is sold together with a parking station on the -2nd floor, which is for two cars. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
